svg.title: Delft map study
svg.desc: Actual OpenStreetMap building footprints, water and streets in a central Delft sample. Narrow parcels and irregular connected blocks.

g.text: Read the fabric, not just the landmarks.
Central Delft · building footprints, canals and street segments · OpenStreetMap extract, 16 October 2026
Ochre: walking/cycling ways · Charcoal: other street ways · Stone: building ways · Blue: water
